learning_outcomes.text: Students should have the opportunity to apply their acquired knowledge in practice at an early stage and at the same time get to know the operational processes in a company.
Internships in companies during studies and the resulting knowledge are a decisive advantage when starting professional life.
The practical activity is carried out in an industrial company or other suitable training company.
Students are involved in current company projects in the areas of development, production, or sales.
The projects processed by the students deal with topics from mechanical engineering and related fields and allow the practical application of knowledge acquired at the university.
They provide an insight into later professional life.
Students are responsible for finding a suitable training company and a suitable project themselves.

syllabus_topics: Participation in concrete projects in a company e.g. in the areas of design and development, production, quality management, …
